items.statement: The supplied neutral doublet radical and four atom selectors are preserved.
items.expected: Charge 0, multiplicity 2, O1 atom 1, C2 atom 2, C6 atom 6 and C4 atom 4 are reported.

items.statement: Populations derive from a converged and validated calculation with provenance.
items.expected: SCF/geometry convergence, atom-map preservation, structure validation and population scheme are documented, or bounded failure is honestly reported.

items.statement: Four site populations and their ordering are reported.
items.expected: Numeric populations for O1, C2, C6 and C4 include units/convention and address C2/C6 equivalence.

items.statement: The conclusion is derived from the submitted site populations rather than an asserted external mechanism.
items.expected: The report explains which site is supported as dominant, or honestly reports that the data do not discriminate, within the isolated-radical boundary.
